title: MTG Grammar and Rules Vocabulary Registry

status_definitions.ontology_defined: This exact controlled vocabulary is explicitly declared in local MTG-DIO v3.1.1 or its hook table; this is not a certification of every game use.
status_definitions.rules_verified: This concept or semantic distinction has been checked against the 2026-09-25 Comprehensive Rules; registry values are normalized where stated and may not be official token spellings.
status_definitions.proposed: Suggested new value domain or enumeration for our vocabulary layer, not canonized into DIO or comprehensive rules. May include examples that are valid Magic concepts.
status_definitions.inventory_observed_candidate: Reserved future per-card annotation status; local inventory parser outputs do not constitute verified operation semantics.

validation_principles: Never infer full mechanical interaction from a shared word or hook identifier alone.
Requirements are AND across groups, OR within groups; amplifiers are not gates.
Timing, priority, payment, zone, identity and event checkpoints must be verified when relevant.
Always distinguish output hook, source operation, and card-level connection evidence.
A list of vocabulary values is not an exhaustive set of all legal game states or all card text.
Do not treat an automatically parsed inventory operation as verified; it is a candidate until its full rule contract is checked.

provenance_notes.subject: canonical_inventory
provenance_notes.text: The inventory reports 4,631 candidate operations from 3,358 owned legal card units, and 253 unconfident classifications in a review backlog; candidate annotations are not verified.

provenance_notes.subject: living_catalogues
provenance_notes.text: Subtype, keyword, abilities, oracle wordings, and other external enumerations change as new sets release. Link to Scryfall catalogs and MTGJSON, do not freeze these domains here.
